shots.text: The Hollow King split in two when he fell. One half was a crown. The other half was a woman made of stars, holding it in her hand.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Hollow King breaking into two shades; one dissolves, the other becomes Nyxara, tall, a starfield for a face, holding a broken iron crown.

shots.text:
I fought it. All this time, I fought it from inside.

And your Grey Lantern walks my road. He is not finished.
shots.speaker: nyxara
shots.art_note: Nyxara looking past the player, toward the Crack, the stars in her face moving.

shots.text: None of us understood her. Not yet.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Umbrael's great telescope turning one last time to face the Crack, then toppling slowly.
